node.title: Re^5: File Upload Size Check
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
"Failed to execute CGI "/cgi-bin/Maintenance_Framework.cgi". Contact your administrator."

That sounds like a message from the web server, not from Perl, so you should check your server's error logs for the message that Perl is giving you. See also [id://165253] and [id://380424].
